A man who had intercourse by day in Ramadan was told to free a slave, fast two months or feed sixty poor; having nothing, he received food for his family.
Troubled by lice in ihram at Hudaibiya, Ka'b b. Ujra was told to shave, fast three days, feed six needy or sacrifice; the verse revealed for him applies to all.
The expiation for breaking a vow is the same as the expiation for breaking an oath.
